cases.theme: Software and security. Strong incident-response evidence, already generated in the paid run.
Healthcare. A nursing aide must not become a new-graduate nurse practitioner.
Accounting. Healthcare collections and reconciliations against a corporate senior-accountant role.
Education. High-school math with a Maryland certificate against a Connecticut math certificate.
Skilled trades. Named conveyor equipment against a 3D-printer maintenance job.
Sales. Quota-bearing medical and diagnostics sales without an invented methodology.
Administration. A dean's assistant with FERPA and grant budgets.
Hospitality. Hotel food-cost management against a fast-casual assistant manager.
Career transition. Hospital discharge planning plus a real teaching job, without a new licence.
Sparse retail. One cashier line, with fashion advising and no invented brand metrics.
Strong domain, weak writing. Thin but genuine LMS bullets.
Stretch with fabrication risk. An electrical supervisor licence must not become staff cloud engineering.
